title: Agent unavailable — delivery retry exhausted → FAILED
description: The agent SA is registered but the agent process does NOT respond. max_delivery_attempts=3. The runner starts a no_op handler (receives but never resumes). After 3 failed delivery attempts the intent transitions to FAILED and the intent.delivery_failed webhook fires. Then demonstrates that with a live auto_complete handler the same intent type succeeds.

agents.description: step 1/1 — no_op: intentionally does NOT resume (simulates unavailable agent)
